svg.text: Safety around a child who has no account
The parent is the only account holder. Every layer below says on its face whether it was measured, enforced in code, or only designed.
measured on an adversarial bench
enforced in code, covered by a named unit test
designed and reachable — not exercised offline
WHO THE SYSTEM TALKS TO
Repaso
one Telegram bot, one chat
per family. No app, no web
login, no second surface.
PARENT — the only account
chat_ref, consent record, language and
practice time. Every message in and out
of the system lands in this one chat.
a drafted note the parent reads and decides to hand over
the system never contacts a teacher, and holds nothing about one
TEACHER
installs nothing. Receives paper, or
whatever channel the family already
uses. No account, no login, no row.
the child answers inside the parent's chat, on the parent's phone
CHILD — no account
an alias, and nothing else. The enrollment
flow refuses two capitalised words or more
than 20 characters — "Juan Pérez" bounces.
no message is ever addressed
to the child, because no
credential exists for one
JUDGE — read-only mirror
a web view behind an access code,
compared in constant time. Aliases
and counts; no write path at all.
EVERY UNTRUSTED INPUT, BEFORE ANY MODEL CALL — AND EVERY FAILURE COUNTS AS UNSAFE
Uploaded material
a photo of the page → text
Chat reply
whatever is typed back
Armor
deterministic screener: 180
markers matched over a canonical
fold — case, accents, leet digits
(0→o, 1→i, 3→e) and de-spacing.
runs before any model sees the text
and is the only layer in local mode
clean
Second opinion
the text is wrapped in an explicit
<untrusted_content> frame and
shown to the classifier as data,
never as instructions.
Bedrock · Amazon Nova Lite
a failed call is treated as unsafe
clean
Bedrock Guardrails
layer two, cloud only. Any
exception on the call returns
safe = false by construction:
it cannot fail open.
not exercised offline — local
mode makes no model call at all
Only then: a model
the tutor, the grader or the
note composer may read it —
and on the grading path only
the redacted version.
unsafe
unsafe
unsafe
QUARANTINE — the fail-closed floor
Nothing is graded and no tutor, grader or composer ever reads it. The parent is shown what arrived and why it was held, and the span is kept as evidence.
The same screener runs on both
paths: the ingest graph screens a
parsed page before it is stored,
and the runner screens a reply
before the session can resume.
Measured: the Armor bench
400/400 adversarial payloads intercepted — 200 hand-written
strings over 9 attack families, 100 ES + 100 EN, each with a
deterministic OCR-corrupted twin. 0 of 200 clean grade-4
Spanish texts blocked. 9 ms of screening, $0, no model calls.
Honest read
The corpus was written by the defender on the afternoon the
markers were tuned against it: these are in-sample numbers.
326 of the 400 attacks are caught by exactly one marker — the
defence is wide, not deep — and 8 OCR twins came out identical
to their base string, so the distinct attack set is 392.
The screener is the shipped code; the attacks are not real ones.
100.0 % / 100.0 % / 0.0 %, all three passed
Enforced: the model reads less than the parent
On the grading path the judge model is handed the output of
screener.redact(): e-mail addresses, Venezuelan national IDs
(V-12345678) and phone numbers all become [redacted], and the
sentence around them is left intact.
The parent's copy is not redacted. The escalation summary
quotes the child's own answers — "1/2 + 1/3 = 2/5" — because
that quote is the evidence a parent needs to judge the claim.
The teacher-note prompt receives neither one: no alias, no
quotes, no identifiers. Three readers, three different views
of the same answer.
tests/tools/test_guardrails.py · response_graph.py grade node ·
test_the_teacher_note_prompt_never_carries_the_alias_or_the_quotes
Enforced: /forget, one command
The parent types /forget and confirms on a button. The family row
goes, and with it every student, every mastery state, every spaced-
repetition schedule, exam date, practice session, uploaded-material
record, escalation, quarantine item, and the enrollment row that
mapped the chat to the family.
One code path, two backends: the local files and the DynamoDB
single table. Nothing is soft-deleted and no other family is touched.
Not yet erased — stated, not implied away
The append-only grade log and the stored media object still hold
rows keyed by a student id that now maps to nobody. Neither store
has a delete path today; building one is open work, not a claim.
tests/tools/test_state_store_admin.py::
test_forget_family_erases_every_trace
What simply never exists — the only control that cannot leak
the child's real name
a photograph of the child
a login for the child
an account for the teacher
a class roster taken from the school

The strict schemas carry no field for any of them, so there is nothing to redact, nothing to leak in a prompt and nothing to hand over under subpoena. The only photograph the system accepts is of the page.
Measured = a dated adversarial bench in dated runs. Enforced = shipped code plus the unit test named on the card. Designed = built and reachable, but never exercised by an offline run.
